display.purpose: One semantic page title per destination.

label.purpose: Fields, metadata headers, and section names.

mono.purpose: Counts, timestamps, identifiers, durations, and percentages.

shadows.name: popover-lift
shadows.purpose: Structural separation for dialogs, menus, and popovers.

shadows.name: signal-glow
shadows.purpose: Rare emphasis for the active primary signal.

motion.name: screen-entry
motion.purpose: A small upward entry for destination changes.

motion.name: button-feedback
motion.purpose: Brief press and focus feedback on controls.

motion.name: surface-feedback
motion.purpose: Bounded hover feedback for interactive cards.

motion.name: reduced-motion

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one current next action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 10px); padding: 9px 15px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent, #f5b323), var(--accent-deep, #b9780a)); color: var(--accent-ink, #15120a); font: 700 12.5px var(--font-body, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -6px var(--accent-glow, rgba(245,179,35,.45)); transition: filter .2s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #f5b323); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A secondary action that remains visible without competing with the next step.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { border: 1px solid var(--border-3, #262b34); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 10px); padding: 9px 15px; background: var(--bg-control, #15181f); color: var(--text-control, #c4cad3); font: 700 12.5px var(--font-body, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, border-color .2s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #20252d); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #f5b323); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact labelled input with explicit focus and recovery states.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; color: var(--text-muted, #aab0bb); font: 600 11px var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--border-2, #23272f); border-radius: 9px; padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--bg-inset, #0e1116); color: var(--text, #e9ebef); font: 400 12.5px var(--font-body, sans-serif); outline: none; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--border-3, #262b34); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent, #f5b323); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, rgba(245,179,35,.13)); }

components.name: Active Chip
components.description: A selected filter or compact categorical choice.
components.css: .ds-chip { border: 1px solid var(--accent, #f5b323); border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 11px; background: var(--accent-soft, rgba(245,179,35,.13)); color: var(--accent, #f5b323); font: 600 11px var(--font-body, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: filter .15s; } .ds-chip:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #f5b323); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Production Card
components.description: The canonical non-interactive container for one production decision or state group.
components.html:
Ready to render

Captions, media, and thumbnail are complete.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--border, #1d2129); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 14px); padding: 16px; background: var(--bg-card, #12151b); color: var(--text, #e9ebef); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card, 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.32)); font-family: var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--text-strong, #f4f6f9); font: 600 16px/1.35 var(--font-display, sans-serif); } .ds-card p { max-width: 62ch; margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--text-muted, #aab0bb); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The current destination inside the primary workflow navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 10px); padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--accent-soft, rgba(245,179,35,.13)); color: var(--text-strong, #f4f6f9); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #f5b323) 26%, transparent); font: 600 13px var(--font-body, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-nav-step { color: var(--accent, #f5b323); font: 700 9.5px var(--font-mono, monospace); } .ds-nav-item:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #f5b323); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ready Status Pill
components.description: Durable compact state for healthy or completed work.
components.css: .ds-status-ready { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok, #36c98e) 44%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 9px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ok, #36c98e) 10%, transparent); color: var(--ok-2, #4fd6a0); font: 600 11px var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-status-ready > span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ok, #36c98e); }

components.name: Confirmation Dialog
components.description: The only destructive or system confirmation pattern.
components.html:
Remove source channel?

This stops future monitoring. Existing production work remains.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(430px, 100%); border: 1px solid var(--border-3, #262b34); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 14px); padding: 20px; background: var(--bg-card, #12151b); color: var(--text, #e9ebef); box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop, 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.55)); font-family: var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0; color: var(--text-strong, #f4f6f9); font: 600 16px/1.35 var(--font-display, sans-serif); } .ds-dialog p { margin: 8px 0 20px; color: var(--text-muted, #aab0bb); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-dialog > div { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; } .ds-dialog button { border-radius: var(--radius-md, 10px); padding: 9px 15px; font: 700 12px var(--font-body, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-cancel { border: 1px solid var(--border-3, #262b34); background: var(--bg-control, #15181f); color: var(--text-control, #c4cad3); } .ds-dialog-danger { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--err, #ff5a6e) 42%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--err, #ff5a6e) 10%, var(--bg-card, #12151b)); color: var(--err-2, #ff8a96); } .ds-dialog button:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-dialog button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #f5b323); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Production Path
components.css: .ds-path { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin: 0; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #1d2129); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 10px); background: var(--bg-inset, #0e1116); list-style: none; font: 600 11px var(--font-body, sans-serif); } .ds-path li { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 8px; color: var(--text-muted, #aab0bb); text-align: center; } .ds-path .done { color: var(--ok-2, #4fd6a0); } .ds-path .current { background: var(--accent-soft, rgba(245,179,35,.13)); color: var(--accent, #f5b323); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #f5b323) 26%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
Mental Empire Studio should feel like one calm, capable production room: dark enough to keep media and progress legible, structured enough to reveal the next action, and dense enough for serious desktop work. Tonal layers separate navigation, work surfaces, and focused controls without turning each feature into a separate visual world.

The visual system is operational rather than ornamental. Accent color behaves like a signal lamp, typography names decisions before details, and status is always paired with plain language. The interface should help a creator move from publishing channel to source, edit, thumbnail, render, and upload without losing context.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, layered production surfaces with restrained depth.
One user-selected signal accent, used sparingly for focus and current action.
Compact desktop typography with readable secondary information.
Clear state, consequence, and recovery at every long-running step.
A connected five-stage production path rather than disconnected tools.

rules.name: The Signal Light Rule
rules.body: One screen gets one active accent voice. Do not combine multiple accent themes or use accent as decoration.

rules.name: The Readable Secondary Rule
rules.body: Secondary text remains at least 4.5:1 on the raised surface; create hierarchy with size, weight, and spacing rather than illegibility.

rules.name: The Fixed Status Rule
rules.body: Emerald means healthy or complete, crimson means failure or danger, amber means attention or queued, and blue means neutral information regardless of the selected accent theme.

rules.name: The One Heading Rule
rules.body: Every destination has one semantic `h1`; do not repeat it with an eyebrow or decorative all-caps pretitle.

rules.name: The Output-Font Boundary
rules.body: Anton, Montserrat, and other expressive faces belong to captions, thumbnails, or rendered media presets—not application chrome.

rules.name: The Production-Minimum Rule
rules.body: Every destination must fit 1100×720 without document-level horizontal overflow; 640px is the zoom-pressure check, not a separate mobile product.

rules.name: The Next-Action Rule
rules.body: The first screenful answers what this destination does, what state the current work is in, and what the creator should do next.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Prefer a neighboring surface tone and a one-pixel border before adding a shadow.

rules.name: The Earned Lift Rule
rules.body: Deep shadows belong to temporary foreground surfaces, not every card.

rules.name: The Bounded Curve Rule
rules.body: Use the established radius scale; do not introduce oversized floating capsules or arbitrary corner values for visual novelty.

dos: Do reuse semantic tokens and the shared kit before creating a local visual variant.
Do make the page outcome, current state, and next useful action clear in the first screenful.
Do use real buttons, labelled fields, semantic landmarks, one `h1`, and visible focus.
Do keep long-running work understandable with progress, plain status text, failure context, and a recovery action.
Do use the product glossary: publishing channel, source channel, Video Studio, production template, B-roll collection, and Ready to Upload.
Do preserve advanced controls behind clear grouping instead of deleting working capability.
donts: Don't add raw recurring colors, magic spacing, or one-off radii when a semantic token exists.
Don't use native `alert` or `confirm`, pointer-only cards, unlabeled icon actions, or decorative fake controls.
Don't turn accent, glow, gradients, oversized type, or motion into decoration without workflow meaning.
Don't expose implementation terms when a creator-facing stage or outcome communicates the same choice.
Don't use poster or caption fonts in application chrome.
Don't suppress every animation globally for reduced motion; remove decorative movement selectively while retaining state feedback.
Don't simplify a screen by removing an important feature or severing its connection to the production path.
